sasayee.desc: Sassayee.com is an e-commerce marketplace currently under active development and continuously evolving. It enables the sale of IT and electronic products through a modern architecture built with Laravel and Vue.js. The project is actively maintained, with ongoing improvements focused on performance, scalability, and user experience.

claudinestore.desc: Human resources management application for Claudine Store. It allows for employee tracking, payroll management, and automatic payslip generation, offering a reliable, fast, and secure solution to simplify administrative management. Also included is the creation of an e-commerce platform for selling computer and electronic equipment, developed with Laravel for the back-end user interface and Tailwind CSS and Chart.js for a modern, responsive, and high-performance design.

scholarchart.desc: Administrative management application designed for employee data entry and tracking, payroll management, and automatic payslip generation. It offers a reliable, fast, and secure solution to simplify human resources management.

boristech.desc:
Boris Tech is an e-commerce platform dedicated to the sale of computer hardware and electronic equipment.
It was designed with Laravel for the backend, Vue.js for the user interface and Tailwind CSS for a modern, responsive and performant design.

walnertech.desc: An e-commerce platform for Walner Tech, specializing in the sale of computer and electronic equipment, developed with Vue.js Laravel and Tailwind CSS.

chataw.desc: A platform dedicated to event planning, offering personalized catering services for weddings, seminars and receptions.

quiz.desc: A student management app that allows users to track payments, courses, and personal academic information efficiently

spes.desc: A complete management system for God Fashion that streamlines orders, stock, and client interactions, built with Laravel and Tailwind CSS.

streaming.desc: An e-commerce platform for Boris Tech that allows users to browse, order, and pay for electronic devices securely, built with Laravel and Tailwind CSS.
